title: 29 November 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 29th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date. It was their 88th show overall at the venue, and also the 13th occasion on which they performed both lunchtime and evening shows there on the same day.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963. This was their 74th overall appearance, including their lunchtime shows.
